codeSandbox.title: Code Sandbox
codeSandbox.description: Run HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code in a secure sandbox environment with live preview. Works completely offline.
codeSandbox.longDescription: A browser-based code sandbox similar to JSFiddle, but completely offline. Edit HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code and see the live preview instantly. No internet connection required - everything runs locally in your browser.

toolInfo.title: How to Use Code Sandbox
toolInfo.description: Write your HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code in the editor panels. The preview will update automatically (if auto-refresh is enabled) or when you click the Run button. You can switch between horizontal and vertical layouts, and choose from built-in templates to get started quickly.
